title: Chunk step on encoded pairs
statement: For bit strings $c$, $r$, and $a$, apply the chunk step to the encoding of $c$ paired with the encoding of $r$ paired with $a$. If $r$ is empty, the result is unchanged. Otherwise, the result pairs $c$ with a pair whose first component is the suffix of $r$ after its first $|c|$ bits and whose second component is $a$ followed by the encoding of the first $|c|$ bits of $r$.
